issues.legal_issue: A legal issue omitted before the High Court and excluded from the questions referred to it cannot be raised for the first time in an appeal from a tax reference.
material_facts: The assessee sought to argue that the cost of acquiring the tenancy rights could not be ascertained, affecting the computation of taxable capital gains.
The Tribunal had refused to refer a question concerning that computation to the High Court, and the assessee did not pursue a further application for a reference.
The assessee did not argue the contention before the High Court.
The Supreme Court considered the appeal from the High Court’s decision in a tax reference.
issues.conclusion: The Supreme Court declined to permit the assessee to raise the contention and dismissed the appeal.
issues.legal_principle: A High Court’s jurisdiction on a reference under Section 256 of the Income-tax Act, 1961, is advisory and confined to issues properly arising from the facts and the questions referred. A question that the Tribunal declined to refer cannot be read into another referred question, and an issue not argued before the High Court cannot be raised in the appeal. The contention based on Commissioner of Income-tax v. B.C. Srinivasa Setty concerned the merits, which the Court did not decide.

rule.if: appeal_from_tax_reference and issue_not_raised_before_high_court and issue_excluded_from_referred_questions and no_further_reference_application

predicates.appeal_from_tax_reference: The proceeding is an appeal from a decision made on a tax-law reference.
predicates.issue_not_raised_before_high_court: The party seeking to rely on the issue did not argue it before the High Court.
predicates.issue_excluded_from_referred_questions: The tribunal declined to refer the issue to the High Court, and it was not included in the questions referred.
predicates.no_further_reference_application: The party did not pursue a further application seeking a reference of the excluded issue.

issues.definition: When an appeal arises from a tax reference and the issue was neither argued before the High Court nor included among the questions referred, with no further reference application pursued, the issue is not entertained in the appeal.
